lexicon: ADJACENCY — regions R1 and R2 share a boundary
description: Two triangles sharing edge AB. The shared edge's two darts lie in two DIFFERENT bounded regions — that is what 'adjacent regions' is, structurally: co-boundary. Connected, so no nesting is needed and the genus formula applies.
